row.notes: (rm, byte *rec, u8 flag): resolves car rec[0] via [rm+0x1c30]; builds a 0x30-byte record (vtable 0x14568deb0, penalty-log layout): +8 car, +9 type 0x13, +0xa flag, +0xb rec[9], +0x10/+0x14 participant +0x58/+0x5c, +0x1c 8, +0x20 rec+0x14, +0x24 session time ([[rm+0x1c68]+0x230] clock), +0x28 lap (Sess_LapTimes_GetCarData([rm+0x1c48],car) +0x9c60^+0x9c68), +0x2c rec+4; submits to [rm+0x1c50] via 0x143564e60. Evaluates nothing. Better name: Sess_Infringement_SubmitLogRecord (bound record keeps its name).
